title: MOSAIC: Scalable Stochastic Simulation with Heterogeneous and Non-Markovian Agents
description:
If you use this code, please cite the article: Pélissier A., Phan M., Le Bail D., Beerenwinkel N., Rodríguez Martínez M. Unifying non-Markovian dynamics and agent heterogeneity in scalable stochastic networks. Nature Communications 17, 3345 (2026). https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-026-69817-y

Reference implementation of MOSAIC, a Gillespie-type framework for the exact simulation of stochastic systems with arbitrary inter-event time distributions (non-Markovian reactions), agent-specific rates and properties, and history-dependent interaction preferences.

The archive contains the core library and the code, data and precomputed results for the three applications of the paper: transcription with heterogeneous delays, clonal B cell competition in germinal centers, and bursty human interactions in temporal networks (MOSAIC-TN).

Latest code: https://github.com/AI-SysBio/MOSAIC
